notes: LIST PRICES: $99 / $145 / $255 / $369 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K. Promotions are excluded because they can change before checkout.
ONE-TIME AND $0 ACTIVATION: Growth has no subscription rebill and no fee to activate the simulated funded account.
SIX-PERCENT TARGET: $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 by tier.
SOFT DAILY LOSS: $600 / $1,250 / $2,500 / $3,750. Reaching it stops trading for the day rather than failing the account by itself.
EOD TRAILING LOSS: $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,500 / $5,000. The dollar caps are tier-specific, so no false shared maxLossPct is stored.
ONE-DAY PASS: Growth has no evaluation consistency rule and can pass after 1 trading day. The 35% field applies to funded payout eligibility, not evaluation failure.
PAYOUT GATE: each cycle needs 5 qualifying profit days: $100 / $150 / $200 / $250 minimum daily profit by tier. The first payout caps are $1,000 / $1,500 / $2,000 / $2,500.
NINETY-PERCENT SPLIT: Tradeify pays the trader 90% on simulated funded requests. Elite Live uses a separate 80/20 split.
DAY TRADING ONLY: every position must close by 4:45 PM ET, so overnight and weekend holding are not allowed.
NEWS IS ALLOWED, subject to the general microscalping rule that more than 50% of trades and more than 50% of profit must come from trades held longer than 10 seconds.

AUTOMATION AND COPYING are restricted: a personal non-HFT bot must be provably owned and used exclusively within Tradeify; copying is allowed only across the trader's own accounts in the same direction.
ALL SALES FINAL: account purchases and reset fees are non-refundable.
